subject.title: feat(plugins): add Computer Use provider contract

question: Should OpenClaw publish `api.registerComputerUseProvider({ id, label })` as a permanent public Plugin SDK contract before the node-host runtime that consumes it is approved and implemented?
rationale: The method is a new external API rather than a mechanical bug fix, and the related manifest-only proposal demonstrates an unresolved decision about whether static ownership alone is the intended boundary.

options.title: Approve the staged SDK seam
options.body: Accept `{ id, label }` as the permanent minimal public contract and land this PR with the stated restriction against transport, permission, platform, and launch fields.

options.title: Defer runtime registration
options.body: Keep or land only the approved manifest discovery shape, then add a public runtime registration API in the node-host PR that proves its consumer and lifecycle.

options.title: Adopt the broader host-metadata direction
options.body: Align the work with the host-discovery metadata proposal and redesign this PR around the selected static contract before exposing runtime registration.

recommendation.title: Defer runtime registration
recommendation.body: Keep or land only the approved manifest discovery shape, then add a public runtime registration API in the node-host PR that proves its consumer and lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa is the strongest available routing candidate across this PR and the preceding related manifest-contract proposal; final API acceptance still requires a maintainer decision.
